title: Decision-Sequence Evidence Schema (DSES)
description: An open, vendor-neutral vocabulary for evidence of how humans and AI make decisions together. DSES defines a ten-event vocabulary for human-AI decision sequences, an eight-class exposure ontology, an information-state and independence model, four integrity classes, and three conformance levels, with mappings to HL7 FHIR AuditEvent and Provenance, IHE Radiology AI profiles, DICOM, and OpenTelemetry.
